structure.unit: Production and Sale of Agricultural Products
Controlled Atmosphere Storage of Apples and Peaches

law.catch_line: Inspection and certification of fruit by Commissioner
law.text:
It is unlawful for any person to place or stamp the letters "CA" or a similar designation in conjunction with a number upon any container or subcontainer of any fruits, unless:
The Commissioner has inspected such fruits and validated a certificate stating their condition, that they were stored in a warehouse registered under the provisions of this chapter and that they meet all other requirements of this chapter or regulations adopted hereunder; and
A certificate number and certificate date is affixed to all shipping documents.
